ask: add CSV export to the reports page
corrections: don't add a dependency for CSV
decisions: keep the export server-side
outcome: CSV export works from the reports page; tests pass.

ask: disable the export button while the download runs
decisions: show a spinner in the button, no toast
outcome: The button is disabled until the download finishes.

ask: fix the cart total rounding error when a discount code is applied
corrections: round once at the end, not per line
decisions: store money as integer cents
outcome: Cart totals round once at the end; added a regression test.

ask: the product images load slowly on the category page
decisions: lazy-load images below the fold, keep the first row eager
outcome: Category page images lazy-load; first paint is faster.

ask: add dark mode to the storefront
corrections: use the existing color tokens, no new hex values
decisions: follow the OS setting, with a toggle in the footer
outcome: Dark mode follows the OS, with a footer toggle.

ask: write a playwright test for the checkout happy path
decisions: run it against the local dev server with seeded products
outcome: Checkout e2e test passes against the local server.

ask: set up the github actions workflow to run the e2e tests on pull requests
decisions: run e2e only on pull requests to main, cache the browsers
outcome: The e2e workflow runs on pull requests and is green.

ask: migrate the shop from webpack to vite
corrections: don't touch the legacy admin bundle
decisions: keep webpack for the admin until Q1
outcome: The storefront builds with vite; admin still on webpack.

ask: the search box drops the last typed character on mobile safari
decisions: debounce on the input event, not keyup
outcome: Fixed: search uses the input event with a 150 ms debounce.

ask: add a CSV export to the reports page
decisions: reuse the server-side exporter, add the orders columns
outcome: Resumed: the CSV export already existed; added the orders columns.

ask: translate the checkout into german and french
corrections: no machine translation in the repo
decisions: use the existing i18n json files, no new library
outcome: Checkout strings are in de.json and fr.json.

ask: why is the order confirmation email sent twice
decisions: make the email job idempotent with the order id
outcome: The webhook retried; the email job now dedupes by order id.

ask: add a sitemap for the product pages
decisions: generate the sitemap at build time
outcome: sitemap.xml is generated on build.

ask: add stripe webhook signature verification
corrections: never log the raw webhook body
decisions: verify with the raw body before JSON parsing
outcome: Webhooks with a bad signature get a 400; tests pass.

ask: add idempotency keys to the charge endpoint
decisions: keys expire after 24 hours, stored in postgres
outcome: Repeated charges with the same key return the first result.

ask: write a migration to split the invoices table into invoices and invoice_lines
decisions: backfill in batches of 1000, not one transaction
outcome: Migration and backfill ran on a copy of staging.

ask: the monthly invoice job times out for big customers
decisions: paginate customers, 200 per batch
outcome: The invoice job pages through customers and finishes.

ask: add rate limiting to the public API
corrections: no redis, keep it in postgres for now
decisions: token bucket per API key, 100 requests a minute
outcome: Rate limiting returns 429 with Retry-After.

ask: upgrade node from 18 to 22 in the billing service
decisions: drop node-fetch, use the built-in fetch
outcome: Runs on Node 22; CI green.

ask: add retries with backoff to the tax provider client
decisions: 3 retries, exponential backoff, only on 5xx and timeouts
outcome: The tax client retries transient failures.

ask: set up structured json logging with request ids
corrections: never log card numbers or emails
decisions: use pino, one request id per request, from the header if present
outcome: Every log line carries the request id.

ask: support partial refunds on a charge
decisions: refunds are separate rows, never edit the charge
outcome: Partial refunds work up to the charged amount.

ask: the currency conversion is off by a cent for JPY
decisions: JPY has no minor unit; use the currency's exponent
outcome: Fixed: amounts use each currency's exponent; JPY test added.

ask: add an openapi spec for the billing endpoints
decisions: generate it from the zod schemas
outcome: openapi.yaml is generated from the schemas.

ask: handle stripe webhooks for disputes
decisions: reuse the signature check, store disputes in their own table
outcome: Dispute webhooks are stored and acknowledged.

ask: deploy the billing api to the staging cluster
corrections: ask before applying anything to production
decisions: deploy with the helm chart, not kubectl apply
outcome: Staging deploy is up; health checks pass.

ask: dunning: retry failed subscription payments
decisions: retry on day 1, 3 and 7, then cancel the subscription
outcome: Failed payments retry on days 1, 3 and 7.

ask: add offline sync to the notes app with indexeddb
decisions: last write wins per note, with a conflict copy
outcome: Notes sync after reconnecting; conflicts make a copy.

ask: add markdown preview to the editor
decisions: render with the existing remark pipeline
outcome: The editor has a live markdown preview.

ask: fix the flaky sync test
decisions: use fake timers for the sync interval
outcome: The sync test passed 50 runs in a row.

ask: full text search across notes
decisions: sqlite fts5 on the desktop app, a simple index on the web
outcome: Search finds words across all notes.

ask: the editor loses the cursor position after autosave
decisions: save without re-rendering the editor
outcome: Fixed: autosave no longer resets the selection.

ask: add keyboard shortcuts for bold, italic and links
decisions: use mod+b, mod+i and mod+k, like common editors
outcome: Shortcuts work in the editor.

ask: package the notes app with electron for mac and windows
decisions: electron-builder, no auto-update yet
outcome: Unsigned mac and windows builds come out of electron-builder.

ask: add tags to notes with a sidebar filter
decisions: tags are plain strings on the note, no separate table
outcome: Tags show in the sidebar and filter the list.

ask: export notes as a zip of markdown files
decisions: one file per note, a folder per tag
outcome: Export makes a zip with a folder per tag.

ask: end-to-end encryption for synced notes
decisions: encrypt on the client with a key derived from the passphrase; the server never sees it
outcome: Synced notes are encrypted before upload.

ask: the sync conflict copy is created even when nothing changed
decisions: compare content hashes before making a conflict copy
outcome: No more empty conflict copies.

ask: add image paste support in the editor
decisions: store images as blobs next to the note, max 5 MB
outcome: Pasted images show inline.

ask: set up the github actions workflow for the electron builds
decisions: build on tags only, on mac and windows runners
outcome: Tagged releases build in CI.
